responsibility: Implements the shared AST traversal and scope-entering behavior for the newer Resolver2_0 name-resolution passes. This file provides DefaultResolver’s concrete visit methods that descend into child nodes, create ribs through NameResolutionContext::scoped for lexical constructs such as modules, functions, blocks, traits, impls, and loops, and selectively recurse into types, patterns, generic arguments, and subexpressions while leaving actual binding and lookup decisions to the specialized TopLevel, Early, and Late resolvers built on top of it.
same_name_distinction: Defines the out-of-line behavior for DefaultResolver by implementing its AST visitor methods, especially the default recursive descent and ctx.scoped rib-management logic for blocks, modules, functions, traits, impls, and similar constructs; the paired header only declares that visitor interface and stores the shared NameResolutionContext reference.
